description: This file defines the SubPanelRowCounter class, which manages counting rows in subpanels within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for setting subpanel definitions, generating SQL queries to count subpanel records, and handling relationships and functions related to subpanel data.

classes.name: SubPanelRowCounter
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to count rows in subpanels of the SuiteCRM system, handling relationship queries and counting mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a focus object.

methods.name: getSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of rows in a specified subpanel.

methods.name: setSubPanelDefs
methods.description: Sets the subpanel definition array for subsequent operations.

methods.name: doGetSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Recursively counts rows in subpanel definitions.

methods.name: getSingleSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to count rows in a single subpanel.

methods.name: makeSubPanelRowCountQuery
methods.description: Builds a SQL query string to count rows based on subpanel relationship data.

methods.name: makeFunctionCountQuery
methods.description: Generates a count query based on a function name derived from the relationship data.

methods.name: selectQueryToCountQuery
methods.description: Converts a SELECT SQL query into a COUNT(*) query for counting rows.
